widgets_values:
# H3 Master: the one MiniMax H3 workflow

One workflow for every MiniMax H3 job. It replaces h3_director, ai_influencer, ref2va_vsa_4step, video_minimax_h3_i2v and video_minimax_h3_r2v.

## The three switches
- **REFERENCE MODE**
  - **On**: a new scene built from your references (characters, outfit, background, prop, motion video, voice sample). Uses the ref2va model.
  - **Off**: animates the **FIRST FRAME** image exactly as it is. Best when the shot must stay the same (podcast, fixed scene). With no first frame it is plain text-to-video. Uses the fl2va model.
- **FINAL QUALITY**: on = full model with FINAL STEPS (20 medium, 40 high). Off = fast draft with the turbo LoRA (4 steps in reference mode, 8 in first-frame mode).
- **FAST ATTENTION**: on = about 2x faster (Sol-Attn in final, VSA in reference drafts). Off = no speed-up.

## Inputs (all optional, "none" = skipped)
- CHARACTER 1 / 2 / 3, OUTFIT, BACKGROUND / LOCATION, PROP / PRODUCT, MOTION VIDEO, VOICE SAMPLE: used in reference mode only.
- FIRST FRAME, LAST FRAME, VOICE TRACK (lips follow this audio): work in both modes.

Image and video slots have an upload button. For the two audio slots, copy the file into ComfyUI/input and press R.

## Typical times (5 s at 1344x768, RTX 5090)
- Reference draft: about 1 min. First-frame draft: about 2 min.
- Final 20 steps with FAST ATTENTION: about 2.3 min. Final 40 steps without it: about 8 min.

## Prompt rules
- In reference mode write "the main character", "the outfit", "the background". The workflow adds the reference numbering (see FINAL PROMPT SENT TO THE MODEL).
- Sharp background: "Deep focus: the background stays sharp and detailed, no background blur."
- Stable camera: "Locked camera, no cuts, no zoom."
- Speech: words in quotes after "Audio:", one short sentence, plus "realistic lip articulation, no exaggerated mouth opening".
- 5-6 s clips hold best. Keep the seed fixed while changing the prompt.

Not included on purpose: SeedVR2 upscaling and the Qwen Image Edit first-frame builder (use their own workflows).
